component: Website composition: structured asymmetry and purpose specific rectangular cards
explanation: Owner: the plain page shells of the previous layout pass are consistent but too plain, repetitive and rigid. The approved Figma Train direction composes a page from rectangular cards of unequal width, height, weight and colour on one underlying grid: a wide main region of horizontal cards beside a column of contrasting feature cards, with content reclaiming the width beneath. Asymmetry must be intentional (one grid, no random gaps), must not reserve an empty column for a small insert, and must keep a sensible reading order and a deliberate mobile order. Cards are purpose built, not one generic card.

classification.rationale: P07 and P16 allow layout variety but give no method for an expressive website composition. Candidate P27 (PR-0003, draft) covers the shell family; structured asymmetry is a composition rule inside it for content websites. Any content site would repeat it. Owner decides.
